assets.purpose: Distant skyline background derived from brochure architectural reference
assets.prompt_subject: Use the supplied office-tower photograph as architectural and color reference, but pull the camera far back for a broad, elevated panoramic skyline photograph. Show an entire cluster of many elegant high-rise office buildings across a modern metropolitan business district at blue hour with subtle warm window lights. Buildings seen from a distant overlook, not a street-level upward close-up. Full cityscape in the lower two thirds, layered skyline and clear deep-blue sky in the upper third. Spacious wide composition, diverse building heights, straight architectural geometry, crisp small windows, refined navy-and-champagne mood. This is a decorative background behind a large central service diagram; no dominant building fills the frame. Remove the original navy corner triangle and do not add graphic overlays, text, logos or watermarks. Output a high detail 3840x2160 landscape photograph.
assets.constraints: Preserve subject and palette; remove pixel blocks; no watermark; navy brochure corner implemented in CSS.
